A safe harbor in a deadly ocean of hostility, the outpost here sells relief to weary adventurers.}} [[The Granite Citadel]] is one of the only two outposts in the Prophecies campaign where [[prestige armor]] can be crafted, the other being [[Marhan's Grotto]]. ==Getting there== To get here the player can go from [[Copperhammer Mines]], through Spearhead Peak, heading North. The entrance is northeast of [[Grenth's Footprint]] portal, via a narrow gap from main path.
